name: Стратегія (1)
description:
It's time for the first real strategy lesson. Strategy and tactics are often seen as opposites in chess. Yet they actually go hand in hand. Where tactics relate to short, spectacular combinations, strategy relates more to the long term. Tactical opportunities typical arise as a consequence of strong strategy.

Strategy is the art of achieving small advantages. These are generally different types of advantages than material advantages. With strategy, we focus mainly on the quality of pieces and the pawn structure.

Within the subject of strategy, you will learn what strong and weak pawns are. What good and bad bishops are. And when a knight or a bishop is the stronger piece.

Part of good strategy is that you learn to think 'prophylactically'. In addition to asking yourself what your own strategic goals are, it is also important to ask yourself what your opponent's strategic goals are. Sometimes the best move is a move that prevents the opponent from achieving his or her strategic goals.

What do you have to do?

Improve your position with a strategic move. When doing this, look at the pawn structure and also take into account what the opponent wants to do.

examples.text: Найкращий хід тут — це тонкий 1.Ba4! Білі змушують чорних йти 1...b5, що створює величезну діру на полі шахівниці c5, якою може скористатися білий король.
Хороший приклад профілактичного мислення. Білі дуже хочуть просунутися пішаком f4-f5, але спритний стрибок коня цьому заважає.

texts: Цим ходом ви потрапляєте в структуру чорного ферзевого флангу.
Це профілактичний хід, щоб запобігти a6-a5 чорних.
Спробуйте створити слабкість на ферзевому фланзі.
Переконайтеся, що слабкий пішак b-шахів не може бути посилений.
puzzles.text: Завдяки тонкій грі на ферзевому фланзі білі створили дві слабкості в таборі чорних. Просунутий пішак на b4 тепер вразливий, і пішак на a6 також слабкий. Пізніше білі можуть спробувати виграти ці пішаки.

texts: This removes a key bishop.
After the queen trade, Black has a weak pawn on e6.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
puzzles.text: White captures the strong bishop on e6. With the discovered attack on the black queen, White also forces a queen trade. In the endgame, White can use the bishop pair and exploit the weak pawn on e6. On the next move, White can immediately attack this weakness with Bc4.

texts: This forces White to recapture awkwardly.
Prevent White from dominating the queenside.
puzzles.text: A useful question is: what does the opponent want to do? White wants to gain space with b4-b5 followed by c5-c6. By exchanging on c5, White is forced to recapture with the b-pawn, making the above plan no longer possible. If White recaptures with the d-pawn, the Black bishop on g7 becomes very strong. Black has powerful ideas like ...Ne4.

texts: This forward knight move forces Black to capture.
White can now enjoy the bishop pair!
Try to force a favorable exchange.
puzzles.text: Black is forced to capture, otherwise pawn a7 falls. Now that an important defender is eliminated, the black king is exposed. The white bishop pair is dominant in this position.

texts: This consolidates the strong passed pawn on d4 and fixes the weak white pawn on e4.
Strengthen your center pawn and fix a weakness.
Це руйнує структуру чорних.
У ендшпілі, що залишився, слон домінує, а прохідний пішак c є сильним.
Спробуйте підірвати структуру чорних.
puzzles.text: Чорні загрожують зміцнити структуру ферзевого флангу за допомогою ...a7-a6. З цим проривом a5-a6 білі якраз вчасно досягли сприятливої ​​трансформації. Після розміну білі мають сильний пасовий пішак c-шахів, і, крім того, білий слон перевершує чорного коня.

texts: This gains space and creates chances for a kingside attack.
Gain space and prevent Black from becoming active.
puzzles.text: White plays a 'light-square strategy' here. Black only has a dark-squared bishop, which can't contest the light squares. After advancing the f-pawn, the e-pawn is effectively blocked. White has full control over the critical e4 square and can launch an attack on the kingside. Despite being a pawn down, White is much better here.

texts: The knight is great here.
After the trade, white dominates the dark squares.
Increase your grip on the dark squares.
puzzles.text: Due to the backward pawn on c6, the entire dark-square complex on Black's queenside is vulnerable. Forcing an exchange of the bishop on e7 increases White's control over these dark squares. Moreover, Black's light-squared bishop is now 'entombed'.

texts: The knight is an octopus on this central square!
After the exchange for the key bishop on b6, Black gets a very weak pawn structure.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
puzzles.text: With the knight's advance, White targets both the bishop on b6 and the pawn on c7. Thus, Black can't effectively capture on d4, despite the pin on the white knight. After the bishop is exchanged, White can defend its pawn to eventually attack Black's weak pawns.

texts: A great prophylactic move, White prevents counterplay with ...b7-b5.
Prevent Black's counterplay.
puzzles.text: It is crucial to ask yourself what the opponent intends to do. Black wants to gain space on the queenside with ...b7-b5. If Black opts for this now, White captures en passant, leaving Black with two weak pawns on c6 and a6.

texts: This removes a key attacker.
After this exchange, Black's pawn structure is weakened.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
Змусити вигідну торгівлю.
puzzles.text: White is already a pawn up and wants to consolidate. In an endgame, a lead in development is less relevant. By exchanging twice on d6, White gains the bishop pair and also creates a weak pawn.

texts: With this prophylactic move, you stop Black's counterplay on the queenside.
Stop Black's counterplay.
puzzles.text: With this prophylactic move, you stop Black's counterplay on the queenside. If Black now chooses to advance the b-pawn, White captures en passant! Then Black has a weak pawn on a6.

texts: Take control of the key e4 square.
Increase your grip on a key square.
puzzles.text: White is eager to gain space with e3-e4. Black prevents this. Thus, the strong position of the black knight on d5 is maintained.
